nodes.text: I am shocked that everyone is taking this HMPV outbreak in China lightly as these new lineages are starting to spread globally. With Flu, RSV, COVID-19, Adenovirus, Measles, Dengue, Oropuche, Malaria, Chandipura, Chikungunya etc around..coinfections with HMPV will be lethal!
